scenario: Clear cycle 2026-02 for Consumer-East-02 before the 36-hour SLA closes.
timeframe: One cycle, a 36-hour window — 11.7 hours remaining at the demo state.
baselineNote: Out of 10, in the manual world.

phases.name: Cycle opens
phases.emotionLabel: Bracing — how bad is this one?
phases.action: Read the cycle state: how many anomalies, how much money, how long is left.
phases.thought: How bad is this cycle and how long do I have?
painPoints: In the old world there is no single view of scope
Scale and clock live in different systems
phases.opportunity: One overview: 207 anomalies, $4,850 at risk, 91.6% confidence, and the SLA countdown in the same frame.

phases.name: Understand the anomalies
phases.action: Ask for the patterns and scan the six groups by accounts, confidence and dollar impact.
phases.thought: Are these random, or is there a cause I can act on?
painPoints: Manual grouping was impossible at 12.4M accounts
Every anomaly felt like a separate problem
phases.opportunity: Six patterns, each with a root cause, a confidence score and a dollar figure — and the edge cases set apart rather than averaged in.

phases.name: Trust the fix
phases.action: Open Missing AutoPay Discount; review all 87 accounts, their confidence, and current versus corrected.
phases.thought: Can I stand behind correcting all of these?
painPoints: One pattern-level score told her nothing about the weakest row
phases.opportunity: A named root cause (CGCM sync failure), 94% confidence, a per-account preview, and the 17 weakest rows surfaced as a choice.
phases.momentLabel: The moment the root cause and the confidence make a bulk fix feel safe.

phases.name: Act and prove it
phases.action: Apply Fix to All for 87 accounts and $850.14; escalate or defer the ambiguous ones.
phases.thought: Done — and I can show exactly what I did.
painPoints: Old audit trails were reconstructed after the fact
Nobody could answer 'who corrected what, and why?' a week later
phases.opportunity: Rebill IDs and a governance log written as she acts, not assembled afterwards.
phases.momentLabel: One click landing in an audit log with a rebill ID per account.

traceability.painPoint: Edge cases get the last twenty minutes
traceability.signal: Five edge cases that fit no pattern
